description: Find songs or tracks that sound similar to, resemble, or are sonically related to a specific released recording. Use when a user asks for songs like a particular track or wants similarity-based track recommendations. MusicAtlas performs canonical track resolution and audio-based similarity search. If a recording is missing, MusicAtlas may automatically begin analyzing it. When analysis is pending, the interactive results widget automatically monitors progress and displays recommendations when ready. Do not call the tool again to check progress.

artist.description: The artist name for the reference track.

track.description: The title of the reference track.
